title: In This World Every Secret You Keep Weighs One Kilo
description: Grandpa Isamu is so heavy with secrets he hasn't left his porch chair in a year, and his granddaughter thinks she can fix it. What secret would you finally let go of? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Isamu: 78-year-old Japanese grandfather, short thinning white hair, thick gray eyebrows, round wire glasses, faded navy cotton jinbei top and matching shorts, wooden geta sandals, no hat
characters.Emi: 9-year-old Japanese girl, black hair in two short low pigtails tied with plain red elastics, sleeveless pale yellow summer dress, white ankle socks, red canvas shoes, small sunburn on her nose, no hat

scenes.say: In this world, every secret you keep adds one kilo. Grandpa Isamu carries forty. He hasn't left his porch chair in a year, and the floorboards bend under him.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the wooden engawa porch of an old 1990s countryside farmhouse in rural japan, summer afternoon, Isamu sits heavily in an old wooden chair, the porch boards visibly sagging beneath its legs, cicada trees behind. [4-7s] Close-up on the wooden engawa porch of an old 1990s countryside farmhouse in rural Japan: Isamu's tired hands resting on his knees, his shoulders slumped low as if pressed down. [7-10s] On the same engawa porch, Isamu tries to lift himself from the chair, strains, and sinks back with a long sigh.

scenes.say: His granddaughter Emi has never kept a secret, so her toes float an inch off the ground. But this summer, for the first time, her feet touch the floor.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the dirt path in front of the old farmhouse in rural Japan, Emi drifts along with her red canvas shoes hovering a little above the ground, smiling. [4-7s] On the wooden engawa porch of the same farmhouse, close-up of Emi's red shoes now standing flat on the porch boards. [7-10s] On the same porch, Emi looks down at her own feet, her smile fading, biting her lip.

scenes.say: So Emi makes a deal: tell me your secrets, Grandpa, and you'll get lighter. Monday he confesses twelve. He ate her pudding. He can't swim. He hates his own cooking.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the wooden engawa porch of an old 1990s countryside farmhouse in rural japan, Emi kneels in front of Isamu's chair, holding out her pinky finger for a promise. [4-7s] On the same porch, Isamu scratches his head looking guilty while Emi gasps, an empty pudding cup on the porch boards between them. [7-10s] Inside the small old farmhouse kitchen, Isamu tastes from a pot of soup and makes a sour face while Emi laughs behind him.

scenes.say: Tuesday, fifteen more. Wednesday, twelve. Thirty-nine secrets gone, and Grandpa stands up from his chair for the first time in a year. But one kilo stays. One secret won't come out.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the wooden engawa porch of an old 1990s countryside farmhouse in rural japan at sunset, Isamu talks with his hands while Emi listens wide-eyed, sitting on the porch edge. [4-7s] On the same engawa porch, Isamu slowly rises from his chair and stands on his own, and Emi jumps up beaming. [7-10s] On the same porch, close-up of Isamu's face, his smile slipping as he presses one hand to his chest and looks away.

scenes.say: So Emi goes first. Her own secret: her family moves to Osaka next week, and she couldn't bear to tell him. Grandpa smiles. His last secret is that he already knew.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the wooden engawa porch of an old 1990s countryside farmhouse in rural japan in evening light, Emi stands in front of Isamu clutching the hem of her yellow dress, tears in her eyes, speaking. [4-7s] On the same porch, close-up of Isamu's face softening into a gentle smile behind his round glasses. [7-10s] On the same porch, Isamu kneels down to Emi's height and rests his hand on her head.

scenes.say: He'd kept quiet so her last summer here stayed happy. Two secrets out, two kilos gone. Their toes leave the porch together. In this world, every secret you keep adds a kilo.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the wooden engawa porch of an old 1990s countryside farmhouse in rural japan, Emi hugs Isamu tightly, both crying and laughing. [4-7s] On the same porch, close-up of Isamu's wooden geta and Emi's red shoes lifting gently off the porch boards side by side. [7-10s] Wide quiet shot of the old farmhouse at dusk, Isamu and Emi floating a little above the engawa porch holding hands, fireflies in the dark garden.
